roadmap.title: Main campaign with the good ending
roadmap.description: Play the whole campaign once. Spare enemies, keep Duke, Damir and Alyosha alive for the good ending, finish the Taiga unseen, and take every diary page, postcard and suit upgrade.

roadmap.title: Chapter-select cleanup
roadmap.description: Before starting New Game+, use chapter select to finish kill counts and resource counters that the first run left open.

roadmap.title: The Two Colonels DLC
roadmap.description: Set Normal difficulty in the main menu, then play the chapter without using a medkit and beat the final Blind One fight without being hit by a throw.

roadmap.title: Sam's Story DLC
roadmap.description: Set Normal difficulty in the main menu, earn the Captain's trust, never die in a Batwing fight, and collect every stash, melody and weapon upgrade.

roadmap.title: New Game+ on Ranger Hardcore and Iron Mode
roadmap.description: Start New Game+ on the finished save with a modification, Ranger Hardcore and Iron Mode, lose two crew members for the bad ending, and pick up the three toys.

achievements.description: Detach all train cars on the MOSCOW level.
achievements.sortReason: Missable while crossing the final Moscow train; both levers are in the same sequence.
achievements.summary: Detach every train car on the enemy train in the Moscow level.

steps.text: Cross the Hansa train after jumping onto it.
At each red emergency lever beside a car door, hold the interact key until the car behind you drops away.
Pull the levers in order. Taking the second lever first can lock you out of the first one; reload an autosave if that happens.

achievements.description: Complete the MOSCOW level.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded at the end of the Moscow level.
achievements.summary: Finish the Moscow level.

steps.text: Blow up the Hansa train and return to your own train.

achievements.description: Name the locomotive.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded in the Winter intermission when the radio finds the station.
achievements.summary: Tune the radio on the train to the station that names the locomotive.

steps.text: At the start of Winter, sit at the radio and tune it until the Ark Project station comes in.

achievements.description: Get into a boat.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded when boarding the first rowboat on the Volga.
achievements.summary: Get into a boat.

steps.text: At the start of the Volga, follow Anna to the north waypoint and climb into the rowboat.

achievements.description: Get into the Trolley.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded after the Catfish is killed at the Terminal.
achievements.summary: Get into the trolley.

steps.text: After the Catfish is dead, turn the wheel near the Terminal entrance, then climb into the trolley behind you.

achievements.description: Find the guitar and teddy bear on the VOLGA level.
achievements.sortReason: Both items are on the Volga main island and silo.
achievements.summary: Pick up the guitar and Nastya's teddy bear on the Volga.

guide.context: Free the prisoner at the guitar camp. It earns a moral point for Duke.

steps.text: After the railcar talk with Miller, ask Nastya about her teddy bear and Damir about the guitar. Both are marked on the map.
For the guitar, clear the bandit camp on the southern end of the main island and climb its radio tower. The guitar leans on a balcony rail at the top.
For the bear, go to the top of the white silo in the south-east. The bear sits on a crate in front of a Demon's nest.
Take both. You do not need to hand them in.

achievements.description: Find the passenger train car.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded at the Volga passenger car.
achievements.summary: Find the passenger train car on the Volga.

steps.text: Ride the trolley back to the brick building held by bandits and clear the camp.
Pull the lever on the upper floor to open the bay doors.
Back the trolley into the passenger car.

achievements.description: Kill the Catfish.
achievements.sortReason: Altar trap in the Volga Terminal before the trolley.
achievements.summary: Kill the Catfish in the Terminal on the Volga.

guide.context: You have three attempts, one per body. Reload your quicksave if all three fail.

steps.text: Make a quicksave and go to the fenced room near the Terminal's big doors. It holds an altar over the water, three hanging bodies and a lever with a red sign.
Cut one body down so the Catfish swims over.
Pull the lever as it strikes. Spikes impale it.

achievements.description: Duke survives.
achievements.sortReason: Needs stealth and rescues on the Volga.
achievements.summary: Keep Duke alive through the Volga level.

guide.context: These are the five Volga moral points. If you fail them, Duke is wounded on the bridge and is lost. Reload when spotted.

steps.text: Do not kill or get seen by any cultist at the church. Knock out with fists only.
Do not kill villagers or surrendering enemies. Free the prisoner at the guitar camp and the three prisoners in the north-east bandit compound.
Take the tugboat from the traders without being seen or killing anyone.
Sneak through the Shantytown to the bridge control room without being seen.

achievements.description: Complete the VOLGA level.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded at the end of the Volga.
achievements.summary: Complete the Volga level.

steps.text: Reach Silantius on the cult's bridge and lower it for the Aurora.

achievements.description: Kill 90 cannibals.
achievements.sortReason: Yamantau has an endless cannibal ambush.
achievements.summary: Kill 90 cannibals.

guide.context: Progress carries across reloads on the same save.

steps.text: In Yamantau, kill the endless cannibals after the crew frees you and during the rail car escape.
Make a quicksave before boarding the rail car and reload to keep killing until the counter finishes.

achievements.description: Complete the YAMANTAU level.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded at the end of Yamantau.
achievements.summary: Complete the Yamantau level.

steps.text: Escape Yamantau with the crew and return to the Aurora.

achievements.description: Drive the Bukhanka.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded on first driving the Bukhanka.
achievements.summary: Drive the Bukhanka van on the Caspian.

steps.text: Reach Damir on the Caspian and climb into the Bukhanka.

achievements.description: Make 50 kills with the Bukhanka.
achievements.sortReason: Run over mutants with the Caspian van.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies by running them over with the Bukhanka.

steps.text: On the Caspian, run over mutants with the van whenever you drive.
Find a group of mutants, quicksave, run them down and reload. A group of five stands near the intersection before the long bridge to Anna's old outpost.

achievements.description: Use the bucket lift on the CASPIAN level to reach the Oasis.
achievements.sortReason: Oasis stealth section on the Caspian.
achievements.summary: Ride the bucket lift to the top of the Oasis on the Caspian.

steps.text: Follow Damir into the Oasis lower level and make a quicksave. Stay undetected and do not kill slaves.
Move through shadows and put out lights. Wait until the slave carrying the water bucket walks away from the pool.
Ride the water wheel in the centre up to the upper level.

achievements.description: Find maps in the laboratory.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded in the Caspian bunker.
achievements.summary: Find the maps in the bunker laboratory on the Caspian.

steps.text: Crawl through the long vents to the map room and drop in.
Take the map from the 2019 section at the far end.

achievements.description: Damir stays with the crew.
achievements.sortReason: Needs the Caspian moral points.
achievements.summary: Keep Damir with the crew at the end of the Caspian.

guide.context: There are nine Caspian moral points. If they are not met, Damir leaves with Giul after the Baron dies.

steps.text: Knock out the thug who ambushes you at the start. Do not kill him.
Get to the lighthouse with no kills and knock out the slave attacking outside it.
Find Giul's mother's photo in the bunker side room beside the Image Analysis diary page, and hand it to Giul.
Knock out all six thugs in the shipwreck slave camp. Do not kill anyone.
Free the slaves on the prison ship without being seen.
At the Oasis, stay undetected, free the caged local, then pull the lever at the very top unseen.
Leave the Baron's refuge undetected. Kill no slaves anywhere.

achievements.description: Complete the CASPIAN level.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded at the end of the Caspian.
achievements.summary: Complete the Caspian level.

steps.text: Escape the Baron's fortress after the Baron dies.

achievements.description: Attend the wedding on the SUMMER level.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded at the Summer wedding.
achievements.summary: Attend the wedding in the Summer level.

steps.text: Join the toast at Katya and Stepan's wedding.

achievements.description: Destroy the biggest statue in front of the children's camp on the TAIGA level.
achievements.sortReason: Statue at the start of the Taiga.
achievements.summary: Break the large statue outside the children's camp on the Taiga.

steps.text: Near the start of the Taiga, walk to the large statue at the top of the first stairs by the school and melee it until a leg breaks off.

achievements.description: Stand your ground against the Bear at the first encounter.
achievements.sortReason: Cemetery fight in the second half of the Taiga.
achievements.summary: Stand and fight the Bear at the cemetery until it runs off.

guide.context: Do not climb the rope ladder to escape, or the fight is skipped.

steps.text: Pick up the Explosive Bolts from the crosses in the cemetery and equip Molotovs if you have them.
At the church gate, make a quicksave, then cut the rope on your left to start the fight.
Throw Molotovs, fire Explosive Bolts, then use normal bolts. Sprint left or right when it charges.
Keep fighting until it breaks through the fence and flees.

achievements.description: Take part in the Admiral's tea party on the TAIGA level.
achievements.sortReason: Admiral's tea party in the Taiga.
achievements.summary: Have tea with the Admiral on the Taiga and play the guitar until he sleeps.

steps.text: Enter the Admiral's home and sit down when he invites you.
Stay seated through the long talk. When he demands a song, pick up the guitar and play until he falls asleep.

achievements.description: Complete the TAIGA level without attacking anyone or getting noticed.
achievements.sortReason: The hardest base achievement; Taiga stealth without any attack.
achievements.summary: Complete the Taiga level without attacking or being noticed by any human.

guide.context: Scripted encounters do not count: the pirates who warn you at the bridge, the surrendering alchemist and trap guards, Olga and the Admiral. If an item needs you to be seen, grab it and reload. It stays collected.

steps.text: Play at night and use quicksaves often.
Do not kill or knock out any bandit, pirate or pioneer. Mutants are fine to kill.
Reload if an enemy starts shooting or the detection music keeps playing.
Finish the level. The achievement shows only when the level ends.

achievements.description: Alyosha does not get wounded.
achievements.sortReason: Granted by a clean Taiga run.
achievements.summary: Do not let Alyosha be wounded at the end of the Taiga.

guide.context: A clean Forest Child run gives this achievement automatically.

steps.text: Cut the tied bandit free at the start.
Do not kill any pirate or pioneer, and do not be seen in the camps.
Finish the level. Olga arrives with the pioneers instead of shooting Alyosha.

achievements.description: Complete the TAIGA level.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded at the end of the Taiga.
achievements.summary: Complete the Taiga level.

steps.text: Beat the Bear in the settlement, then ride the zip line to the Aurora with Alyosha.

achievements.description: Pass the putrid tunnel.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded in the Dead City metro.
achievements.summary: Pass the putrid tunnel in the Dead City.

steps.text: Paddle the flooded metro tunnel, passing the leeches and the clean-air stretch, until you reach the big train depot.

achievements.description: Pass the Research Facility without killing a Blind One on the DEAD CITY level.
achievements.sortReason: Institute without killing a Blind One.
achievements.summary: Pass the Research Facility in the Dead City without killing a Blind One.

guide.context: You may be detected. Only killing one breaks the requirement.

steps.text: Sneak or sprint past each Blind One. They hear and smell you but cannot see.
Avoid the broken glass on the floor. It makes noise.
Let the final scripted fight play out without killing any Blind One.

achievements.description: Duke and Damir stay with the crew and Alyosha does not get wounded.
achievements.sortReason: Granted at the end if Duke, Damir and Alyosha are all saved.
achievements.summary: Finish the game with Duke, Damir and Alyosha all alive and unhurt.

steps.text: Meet the Duke, Damir and Alyosha requirements in the Volga, Caspian and Taiga. It unlocks at the end of the game.

achievements.description: Complete the game in Ranger Hardcore mode.
achievements.sortReason: Whole game on Ranger Hardcore.
achievements.summary: Complete the game on Ranger Hardcore difficulty.

guide.context: Enemies hit harder and spot you sooner. You have no reticle and a stripped HUD. Weapons dirty faster.

steps.text: Choose Ranger Hardcore when you start the game. Pick Minimal Interface for a faint HUD.
Rely on autosaves. Quicksave is off.

achievements.description: Save Anna by paying the ultimate price.
achievements.sortReason: Bad ending needs two of three crew lost.
achievements.summary: Get the bad ending by losing at least two of Duke, Damir and Alyosha.

guide.context: Kill surrendering enemies and prisoners too. Lose any two crew members and you get this ending.

steps.text: Volga: kill cultists in the church and get seen on the bridge so Duke dies.
Caspian: kill the rooftop thug and slaves, and free no slaves so Damir leaves.
Taiga: kill the bound bandit near the start, shoot pirates and pioneers in their camps, and let Alyosha get wounded.
Finish the game.

achievements.description: Assume command of the Order.
achievements.sortReason: Good ending needs at least two of three crew alive.
achievements.summary: Get the good ending by keeping at least two of Duke, Damir and Alyosha alive.

steps.text: Spare slaves, prisoners and surrendering enemies. Earn the moral points in the Volga, Caspian and Taiga.
Finish the game. The ending credits unlock it.

achievements.description: Make at least one kill with every ranged weapon.
achievements.sortReason: One kill with each of ten weapons.
achievements.summary: Get a kill with each of the ten weapon types.

steps.text: Shambler: your first weapon in Moscow.
Kalash: from the first fight in the Moscow mall.
Revolver: given to you at the Hansa compound in Moscow.
Tikhar: given to you aboard the Aurora on the Volga.
Bastard Gun: on a wrecked boat near the Aurora on the Volga.
Ashot: on a crate in the Volga safe house near the Aurora, or in Yamantau.
Gatling: from the heavy cannibal in Yamantau.
Valve: on a table at the Caspian outpost, or from the crane sniper.
Bulldog: carried by thugs at the Caspian lighthouse.
Helsing: the crossbow on the statue at the start of the Taiga.

achievements.description: Install a modification of each category on a single weapon.
achievements.sortReason: Mods collected on the Volga fill all five slots.
achievements.summary: Fit one mod from each of the five categories on a single weapon.

guide.context: The Kalash found on the small island in the Volga bay has a Red Laser, which completes five for it.

steps.text: Loot mods from enemy weapons and the world. Fit a stock, barrel, scope, magazine and gadget on one weapon at a workbench.

achievements.description: Spend 500 chemical resources on cleaning weapons.
achievements.sortReason: Dirty and clean weapons with reloads.
achievements.summary: Use 500 chemical resources to clean weapons.

guide.context: The Volga is easiest because of its water and workbenches. Quicksave is off on Ranger Hardcore.

steps.text: Jump in water or mud so all weapons get dirty, then quicksave at a workbench.
Clean the weapons, reload the quicksave once Artyom has readied his weapon, and repeat.
If the count stalls, play on until an autosave occurs, then repeat.

achievements.description: Spend 500 consumable resources on crafting.
achievements.sortReason: Builds from crafting through the Volga and later chapters.
achievements.summary: Spend 500 consumable resources on crafting.

steps.text: Craft ammo, throwables, medkits and filters. Steel balls for the Tikhar use a lot.

achievements.description: Find all upgrades for Artyom's suit.
achievements.sortReason: Eight Volga and five Caspian pickups; lost if the Caspian is left.
achievements.summary: Find every upgrade for Artyom's suit on the Volga and Caspian.

guide.context: Chapter select does not carry suit upgrades between runs. If you miss one, replay from that point.

collectibles.name: Compass
collectibles.method: Go to the cockpit and take it from the floor between the pilot seats.

collectibles.name: Battery Charge Controller
collectibles.method: Refuel the generator in the container with the blue gas can, flip the house switch, charge the electric box with the battery charger and take it from the pinned Humanimal.

collectibles.name: Extended Filter
collectibles.location: @loc{Safe house container} at the north end of the main island
collectibles.method: It lies on a long box at the back of the room.

collectibles.name: Ammo Pouches
collectibles.method: It sits on a crate in the sleeping area west of the exit door.

collectibles.name: Throwing Weapon Harness
collectibles.location: @loc{Gas station}, east coast of the main island
collectibles.method: Shoot the padlock on the back room and take it from the metal shelf.

collectibles.name: Reinforced Helmet
collectibles.location: @loc{Ruined building} on the second-largest island, south-east
collectibles.method: Clear the bandits and take it from a ground-floor room.

collectibles.name: Metal Detector
collectibles.location: @loc{Padlocked shack} west of the white silo
collectibles.method: Shoot the padlock and take it from the desk.

collectibles.name: Night Vision Goggles
collectibles.method: Open the wooden door with the key from the north-east bandit compound prisoners and take the goggles from the altar.

collectibles.name: Motion Scanner
collectibles.method: Climb the ladder and take it from the table in the room across to the left.

collectibles.name: Extra Bright Flashlight
collectibles.location: @loc{Beached boat} at the crossing south-west of the lighthouse cave
collectibles.method: Take it from the crate by the cot. Watch for the tripwire.

collectibles.name: Armored Glass
collectibles.method: Clear the camp, climb the rope ladder and take it by the crafting table.

collectibles.name: NVD Amplifier
collectibles.method: Fight to the top room and take it from the chair.

collectibles.name: Consumables Carrier
collectibles.location: @loc{Cave} on the coast north of the airfield
collectibles.method: Take it beside the workbench.

achievements.description: Patch the Gasmask.
achievements.sortReason: Happens when a hit damages the mask early on the Volga.
achievements.summary: Patch the gas mask after it is damaged.

steps.text: Wear the gas mask and take hits until the mask gets damaged, then press the patch key (G).

achievements.description: After running out of filters in a hazard zone, craft a new one while suffocating.
achievements.sortReason: Needs a hazard zone and a saved game; the Volga bunker works.
achievements.summary: Craft a new air filter while suffocating after you run out of filters in a gas mask area.

guide.context: Radiation spots on the surface do not count as a gas-mask area.

steps.text: In a gas-mask area, such as the bunker where Anna falls on the Volga, make a quicksave.
Open the crafting backpack and dismantle all of your filters.
Wait until Artyom starts suffocating, then craft one filter.
Reload your quicksave afterward.

achievements.description: Kill 300 mutants.
achievements.sortReason: Comes from normal play across the open levels.
achievements.summary: Kill 300 mutants.

steps.text: Kill non-human enemies as you play. Resting at safe houses respawns them.

achievements.description: Kill 50 enemies at long distance.
achievements.sortReason: Caspian crane sniper nest with reloads.
achievements.summary: Kill 50 enemies at long distance.

steps.text: On the Caspian, drive east toward the crane near Anna's old outpost.
Kill the sniper at the base and take his Valve rifle, then climb to the sniper nest at the top.
Quicksave. A truck unloads six thugs at the other end of the bridge. Shoot all six from the nest, then reload and repeat.

achievements.description: Kill 30 enemies with Tikhar.
achievements.sortReason: Volga's Tikhar is the main source; the count builds with play.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies with the Tikhar.

steps.text: Keep the Tikhar equipped on the Volga and craft steel balls in the backpack for ammo. Humanimals at the Port are good targets.

achievements.description: Kill 30 enemies with Crossbow.
achievements.sortReason: Taiga bandit camp with the Helsing.
achievements.summary: Kill 30 enemies with the Helsing crossbow.

steps.text: Take the Helsing at the start of the Taiga.
Use it on the bandit camp past the cave. Quicksave first and reload after, so your stealth run stays clean.

achievements.description: Kill 300 human enemies.
achievements.sortReason: Human enemy kills in bandit camps.
achievements.summary: Kill 300 human enemies.

guide.context: Do not count on cannibals in Yamantau.

steps.text: Clear bandit and thug camps on the Volga, Caspian and Taiga.
Quicksave, kill the camp, reload and repeat.

achievements.description: Melee-kill or stun 50 enemies.
achievements.sortReason: Takedown and stun kills with reloads.
achievements.summary: Melee-kill or stun 50 enemies.

steps.text: Use the takedown prompt on enemies, or knock them out. Hitting an enemy with the weapon to kill does not count.
Quicksave near a group, repeat the takedowns and reload.

achievements.description: Kill 3 enemies using sniper scope while wearing the Gas mask and using the Night Vision goggles.
achievements.sortReason: Needs the Terminal goggles and a 4x scope.
achievements.summary: Get three kills through a sniper scope while your gas mask is on and your night vision goggles are active.

steps.text: On the Volga, free the villagers at the north-east bandit compound to get the key, then use it on the wooden door in the Terminal.
Take the goggles from the altar in the secret room.
Fit a 4x or stronger scope on a weapon, put on the gas mask and switch on the goggles.
Kill three humanimals in the Terminal.

achievements.description: Kill a demon with fire.
achievements.sortReason: The Demon nest is on the silo with the teddy bear.
achievements.summary: Kill a Demon with fire.

steps.text: Carry at least two Molotovs and climb the white silo in the south-east.
Throw Molotovs at the Demon at its nest, or while it circles, until it dies.

achievements.description: Find all 70 hidden Diary pages.
achievements.sortReason: 71 pages across all base levels.
achievements.summary: Find every hidden diary page in the base game.

guide.context: The achievement lists 70 pages, but there are 71. The pause menu's Collectibles tab shows what you are missing by level.

achievements.description: Find a tune on the radio.
achievements.sortReason: Available on the Aurora's radio in the intermissions.
achievements.summary: Find a music station on the radio.

guide.context: The Winter intermission has a music station near 26 on the dial.

steps.text: Sit at the radio on the Aurora between levels and tune it slowly until music plays.

achievements.description: Find 3 toys in New Game+ mode: teddy bear, sun and fish.
achievements.sortReason: Three NG+ toys in the open levels.
achievements.summary: Find the three toys in New Game+: the Fish, the Sun and the Bear.

guide.context: Start New Game+ first. Nastya's teddy bear does not count. Toy positions can differ between saves.

collectibles.name: Fish
collectibles.method: Behind you, an upright boat leans on the wall and the fish dangles in front of it. Other spots: a shack near the depot lookout, or a small room under the rail overpass north-east of Duke's rail car.

collectibles.name: Sun
collectibles.method: Look on a shelf stacked with cardboard boxes. It can also hang in the second floor of Giul's lighthouse.

collectibles.name: Bear
collectibles.location: @loc{School} at the start of the level
collectibles.method: Enter the school, turn right through the doorway and find it hanging from the window frame above the real teddy bear. It can also hang in front of the map behind the Admiral.

achievements.description: Complete the game in New Game+ mode using any modification.
achievements.sortReason: Any NG+ modification.
achievements.summary: Complete the game in New Game+ with at least one modification chosen.

guide.context: Iron Mode counts as a modification.

steps.text: Finish the game once, then start New Game+ on that save and pick any modification.

achievements.description: Complete the game in Iron Mode.
achievements.sortReason: Whole game in Iron Mode.
achievements.summary: Complete the game in Iron Mode.

guide.context: Set quick-time events to Press in the accessibility options and play on Reader difficulty to make this easier.

steps.text: Finish the game once. Start New Game+ on the same save and turn Iron Mode on.
Finish each level in one sitting. The only saves come at the level ends.

achievements.description: Celebrated the New Year in THE TWO COLONELS Chapter.
achievements.sortReason: Story event in The Two Colonels.
achievements.summary: See in the New Year during The Two Colonels chapter.

steps.text: Reunite with Kirill at Prospekt station and see in the New Year.

achievements.description: Make a moral choice in THE TWO COLONELS Chapter.
achievements.sortReason: Story choice in The Two Colonels.
achievements.summary: Choose between two moral options during The Two Colonels chapter.

steps.text: When your soldiers confiscate Petrovich's stock, choose to take everything or only the excess. Either choice counts.

achievements.description: Provide guidance for Kirill in THE TWO COLONELS Chapter.
achievements.sortReason: Story event in The Two Colonels.
achievements.summary: Give Kirill guidance during The Two Colonels chapter.

steps.text: After the Prospekt riots, finish the radio conversation with Kirill.

achievements.description: Complete THE TWO COLONELS Chapter.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded at the end of The Two Colonels.
achievements.summary: Complete The Two Colonels.

steps.text: Find the satellite maps and sneak out of the Blind One area until Miller finds you.

achievements.description: Kill 3 Nosalises with flamethrower's melee attack in THE TWO COLONELS Chapter.
achievements.sortReason: Nosalis waves in the third part.
achievements.summary: In The Two Colonels chapter, melee three Nosalises to death with the flamethrower.

steps.text: In the bunker garage, turn the switch that opens the blast door, then make a quicksave.
Melee Nosalises with the flamethrower until three have died. The count is cumulative.

achievements.description: Dodge all of the Blind One's throwing attacks in THE TWO COLONELS Chapter.
achievements.sortReason: Final Blind One fight.
achievements.summary: Avoid every throw from the Blind One in the final fight of The Two Colonels.

guide.context: You cannot save during the fight. One hit from a thrown body breaks it, so reload your quicksave and try again.

steps.text: Before the fight, fit the flamethrower upgrades from the dead stalker, craft fuel and make a quicksave.
When the first wave of Nosalises ends and the Blind One enters, sprint at once to the side to dodge its scripted throw.
Stay close to it and spray it with the flamethrower so it throws less. Keep moving.
Kill the second wave, then repeat against the Blind One until the cutscene.

achievements.description: Complete THE TWO COLONELS Chapter without using any Medkits on Normal or higher difficulty.
achievements.sortReason: No medkits for the whole chapter.
achievements.summary: Complete The Two Colonels on Normal or higher difficulty without using any medkit.

steps.text: Set the difficulty to Normal in Game Options before you start.
Never use a medkit. Dismantle medkits at workbenches.
Quicksave often and reload when hurt.
Using one medkit breaks the achievement, even if you reload. Do not change difficulty mid-run.

achievements.description: Organize a documentary screening in the SAM'S STORY chapter.
achievements.sortReason: Projector in the theatre.
achievements.summary: Show a documentary on the projector in Sam's Story.

steps.text: In the theatre during "Find the Captain", go to the second floor projector room and eject the current tape.
Cross the plank to the music room, then enter the room off the hallway to the right and take the new tape from the shelf at the back.
Return to the projector and insert the new tape.

achievements.description: Set all 5 traps in the SAM'S STORY chapter as the Captain requests.
achievements.sortReason: Captain's hideout traps.
achievements.summary: Arm all 5 mutant traps in the Captain's hideout in Sam's Story.

steps.text: After the night with the Captain, craft five Molotovs at the bench in his room.
Find each trap by the painted X marks and numbers 1 to 5 and attach a Molotov to it.
Do not leave on the zip line until all five are armed.

achievements.description: Complete SAM'S STORY on Normal or higher difficulty without dying in Batwing encounters.
achievements.sortReason: Three Batwing fights without dying.
achievements.summary: Finish Sam's Story on Normal or harder without dying once in a Batwing fight.

guide.context: A death in any of these fights breaks the achievement for the playthrough, even if you reload.

steps.text: Set Normal difficulty in Game Options first.
Quicksave before each of the three fights and carry medkits. The Ashot is the best weapon.
Fight 1: on the zip line track after the sky-elevator ruins. Stay opposite the shaking trees.
Fight 2: in the scrapyard with piled cars. Stay out from under high stacks and use medkits.
Fight 3: after you take the environment suits from the fire depot. Watch the trees and dodge the bat swarms.
Complete the chapter. The achievement shows only after the ending.

achievements.description: Complete the SAM'S STORY chapter.
achievements.sortReason: Awarded at the end of Sam's Story.
achievements.summary: Complete Sam's Story.

steps.text: Finish the chapter by making the final choice about the submarine.

achievements.description: Complete the SAM'S STORY chapter earning the Captain's full trust.
achievements.sortReason: Captain's trust tasks through the chapter.
achievements.summary: Complete Sam's Story having earned the Captain's full trust.

guide.context: Keep hints on. A screen flash shows each trust point.

steps.text: Lower your gun when the Captain tells you to.
Help him move the wooden beam.
Choose to punch the Bandit Sniper instead of killing him.
Give him food when he wishes for something to eat.
Arm all five traps in the hideout.
On the boat in the fog, follow the marked path through the marsh to the tower and learn what happened to his crew.
At the end, use the detonator to blow up the submarine.
